kind: bounded engineering source comparison; not a comparative model benchmark
authority: Research only; no paid generation, publication, platform installation or personal state access.
intervention: None. Measure the existing lexical compiler boundary before proposing a change.
oracle: Two dependency-bearing or explicitly negated assignments must remain sequential. A genuinely explicit parallel pair may share a group. Repeated names alone do not permit concurrency.

instructions: Migrate the schema. Do not run in parallel with the reader.
Read the migrated schema after the migration completes.
Inspect the parallel execution bug and write the finding file.
Read the finding file and repair the bug.
In parallel: review documentation in directory A.
In parallel: review independent documentation in directory B.
Read that manifest and validate it.

sample_limit: Four authored fixtures, exposed to this reviewer. They are not independent held-out tasks, human judgments, a full-language semantics suite or runtime acceptance.
decision_rule: Retain source and result. Do not introduce a regex fix solely to fit these four cases. A later compiler change needs explicit dependency representation, a separately frozen holdout and current-host recipe validation.
budget: One local pure-function probe; zero model/provider/tool execution calls. No candidate source mutations.
